quote: 1. I've learned that when you have tremendous conviction on a trade, you have to go for the jugular. It takes courage to be a pig.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 2. Buy high and sell higher; the best stocks are the ones already showing strength.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 3. I always sell a stock if it drops 7 or 8 percent below my purchase price.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 4. I've never used valuation to time the market. Valuation only tells you how far something can go once a catalyst is in place.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 5. Only buy stocks in a Stage 2 uptrend, and never buy a stock in a Stage 4 decline.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 6. I like to buy stocks as they break out of a base to new highs on heavy volume.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 7. Limit your risk on any single trade to 1.25% to 2.5% of your capital.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 8. The first priority is to preserve capital; you can't make money if you're out of the game.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 9. I never fall in love with a stock; when it breaks my rules, I sell it.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 10. Earnings don't move the overall market; it's the Federal Reserve Board. Focus on the central banks and focus on the movement of liquidity.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 11. Even if you're right only half the time, you can make good money as long as your average gain is at least twice your average loss.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 12. A good stock acts right from the day you buy it; if it hangs around your buy point and doesn't move, I get out.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 13. Position sizing is what separates survivors from casualties; size up only when the evidence and the tape agree.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 14. The trend is your friend until liquidity says otherwise; watch what the central banks do, not what companies say.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 15. Watch the leaders: when the best stocks stop going up on good news, the market is telling you something.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 16. The way to build long-term returns is through preservation of capital and home runs.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 17. A 50% loss requires a 100% gain just to get back to even.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 18. I look for stocks with the best earnings growth and relative strength, and buy them when they break out of a proper base.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 19. Soros has taught me that when you have tremendous conviction on a trade, you have to go for the jugular.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 20. Knowing what not to buy is as important as knowing what to buy.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 21. I'm not afraid to be wrong, but I'm afraid to stay wrong.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 22. It's not whether you're right or wrong that's important, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 23. Your objective is not to be right, but to make money.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 24. The big money is made by holding on to the few big winners.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 25. The ability to admit mistakes quickly is paramount.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 26. Sometimes the best trade is no trade at all.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 27. It's just a matter of figuring out which stocks are going to be leaders and buying them early in the move.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 28. The greatest investors make large concentrated bets where they have a lot of conviction. They're not buying 35 or 40 names and diversifying.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 29. To compound your capital rapidly, you must be where the action is.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 30. It's more important to make money than it is to be right.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 31. Soros doesn't give a damn about where he got in. That was the most important lesson I learned from him.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 32. You don't have to be right all the time to be successful; you have to keep your losses small.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 33. I'd rather pay up for a stock that is proven strong than buy a cheap one that isn't working.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 34. Bulls make money, bears make money, and pigs get slaughtered. I'm here to tell you I was a pig a lot of times.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 35. Never average down.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 36. I only buy a stock when it is showing me it's right.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 37. The first thing I heard when I got in the business, from a very smart man, was 'Bulls make money, bears make money, and pigs get slaughtered.'
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 38. Cash is a position.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 39. The market is the best indicator; the leaders will tell you what is going on.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 40. It's not what you make on your winners, but what you give back on your losers that determines success.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 41. You have to be flexible, and when you're wrong, get out. Pride is the enemy.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 42. I try to find stocks that are doing something right now, with strong earnings and strong price action.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 43. It's better to lose correctly than to win incorrectly.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 44. There is no intelligent reason to increase your trading size if your positions are showing losses.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 45. You can be far more aggressive when you're making good profits.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 46. If something needs to be hedged, you shouldn't have a position in it.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 47. To compound your money, and not your mistakes, your goal is to buy on the way up—not on the way down.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 48. Both opportunity and perils surface suddenly in the market.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 49. A stock doesn't know you own it.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 50. Price and volume tell you everything you need to know about a stock.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 51. What matters is the direction of change, not the level.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 52. The market doesn't care about your opinion; it only cares about price.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 53. I've never had a down year because I'm obsessed with not losing money.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 54. The best way to avoid big losses is to take small ones early.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 55. The very best money is made at the market turns. Everyone says you get killed trying to pick tops and bottoms and you make all your money by playing the trend in the middle. Well, for twelve years I've been missing the trend in the middle but I've made a lot of money at tops and bottoms.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 56. Let the market tell you what to do; don't tell the market what to do.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 57. I don't try to predict the market; I react to what the market is telling me, and I get out the moment it says I'm wrong.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 58. I've learned many things from George, but perhaps the most significant is to emphasize capital preservation and use leverage conservatively.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 59. Every stock I buy has a plan for how I'll get out if I'm wrong.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 60. The first rule is to protect your capital; then the profits take care of themselves.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 61. Take care of the downside, and the upside will take care of itself.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 62. The key is to be humble when you're wrong and aggressive when you're right.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 63. The best stocks come out of solid bases and break out on heavy volume.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 64. Letting losses run is the most serious mistake made by most investors.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 65. The stocks that make the biggest gains are the ones that lead the market out of a correction.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 66. The first thing to figure out is whether liquidity is expanding or contracting.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 67. I bought $6 billion worth of tech stocks, and in six weeks I had lost $3 billion in that one baby.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 68. Never let a big winner turn into a loser.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 69. The stocks that hold up best during a market correction are often the biggest winners afterward.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 70. Put all your eggs in one basket and then watch the basket very carefully.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 71. The secret to successful trading is to lose as little as possible when you're wrong.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 72. The best stocks are the ones that make new highs.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 73. Never, ever invest in the present.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 74. Cut your losses short and let your winners run.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 75. The strongest stocks are usually the ones that go on to lead the market.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 76. Investing is not about being right; it's about knowing what the market is already discounting.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 77. Amateurs think about how much money they can make; professionals think about how much they can lose.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 78. Stocks that lead their group out of a correction are the ones I want to own; I let price action, not opinion, make the decision.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 79. Always remember that the market is a discounting mechanism: it prices the future, so by the time the news is good, the move is usually over.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 80. Losses are a cost of doing business; the key is to keep them small enough that you are always able to take the next trade.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 81. The best stocks keep going up longer than you think they should, so do not sell a strong leader just because it has already made money.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 82. It doesn't matter where you got in; all that matters is where the market is going from here.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 83. Don't buy a stock because it looks cheap; buy it because it is going up.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 84. I never buy a stock because it's cheap; I buy it because it's moving.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 85. Your first loss is your best loss.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 86. I don't argue with the tape; if the price action says I'm wrong, I step aside.
speaker: David Ryan

quote: 87. The price of a stock reflects what earnings will be eighteen months from now, not what they are today.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 88. Whenever I get overconfident, I get hurt.
speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller

quote: 89. Think big, but risk small.
speaker: Mark Minervini

quote: 90. The key to success is to cut your losses quickly and let the market prove you right.
speaker: David Ryan
